units.section_heading: Before we redesign anything
units.spoken_text: Every serious reform project eventually faces the same temptation: skip the diagnosis and start selling the cure.

direction.performance_note: Opening thesis. Measured; do not sell.

units.section_heading: Before we redesign anything
units.spoken_text: This book refuses that shortcut.

units.section_heading: Before we redesign anything
units.spoken_text: Constitutional Capitalism was designed, written, attacked, and certified as a technical system first. Stage 4 tried to break it. What survived is what we are allowed to explain.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] Constitutional Capitalism was designed, written, attacked, and certified as a technical system first. Stage 4 tried to break it. What survived is what we are allowed to explain.

units.section_heading: Before we redesign anything
units.spoken_text: But before we explain what could change, we have to say — plainly — what Arkansas inherited.

direction.performance_note: Definitional turn — what Arkansas inherited. Leave space.

units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] But before we explain what could change, we have to say — plainly — what Arkansas inherited.

units.section_heading: Before we redesign anything
units.spoken_text: Not a slogan about Arkansas. Not a statewide average pretending to be a family's life. The actual operating system: people, households, production, public money, assets we can see, and dependencies we often discuss more confidently than we measure.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] Not a slogan about Arkansas. Not a statewide average pretending to be a family's life. The actual operating system: people, households, production, public money, assets we can see, and dependencies we often discuss more confidently than we measure.

units.section_heading: Meet the guides we will keep returning to
units.spoken_text: A political-economy book can disappear into abstractions. We will not.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] A political-economy book can disappear into abstractions. We will not.

units.section_heading: Meet the guides we will keep returning to
units.spoken_text: Throughout this book we return to two guides.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] Throughout this book we return to two guides.

units.section_heading: Meet the guides we will keep returning to
units.spoken_text: First: the Rivers household — an analytical illustration of a rural working family. They are not a real family presented as data. They exist so that when we talk about taxes, healthcare capacity, housing, ownership, or AI, you can ask a concrete question: what does this do to their time, their risk, and their children's options?

direction.performance_note: Introduce Rivers: warm, analytical, not melodrama.

units.section_heading: Meet the guides we will keep returning to
units.spoken_text: Second: Phillips County — a real place, bound with public facts. Between 2020 and 2023 its population fell by 1,479 people. In 2023, about 34.2% of people there lived in poverty. Median household income was about $37,338. Statewide numbers can sound reassuring while a county like this is living a different Arkansas.

direction.performance_note: Phillips County FACT — respectful, not pity.

units.section_heading: Meet the guides we will keep returning to
units.spoken_text: When statewide medians and local facts disagree, this book sides with honesty: Arkansas is not demographically uniform, and prosperity policy that pretends otherwise is already wrong.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] When statewide medians and local facts disagree, this book sides with honesty: Arkansas is not demographically uniform, and prosperity policy that pretends otherwise is already wrong.

units.section_heading: People first — the state is not an abstraction
units.spoken_text: Arkansas is home to about 3.03 million people. Statewide median household income in the bound ACS series is about $58,773.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] Arkansas is home to about 3.03 million people. Statewide median household income in the bound ACS series is about $58,773.

units.section_heading: People first — the state is not an abstraction
units.spoken_text: Those two facts are useful — and dangerous — if left alone.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] Those two facts are useful — and dangerous — if left alone.

units.section_heading: People first — the state is not an abstraction
units.spoken_text: Useful, because they locate Arkansas' scale. Dangerous, because they can erase Phillips County, Mississippi County, and other designated rural places where population loss and elevated poverty arrive together.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] Useful, because they locate Arkansas' scale. Dangerous, because they can erase Phillips County, Mississippi County, and other designated rural places where population loss and elevated poverty arrive together.

units.section_heading: People first — the state is not an abstraction
units.spoken_text: For the Rivers household, 'the Arkansas average' is not a paycheck. It is a rumor about someone else's month.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] For the Rivers household, 'the Arkansas average' is not a paycheck. It is a rumor about someone else's month.

units.section_heading: People first — the state is not an abstraction
units.spoken_text: So the opening X-Ray begins with people, then immediately refuses to let a statewide number become a local truth.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] So the opening X-Ray begins with people, then immediately refuses to let a statewide number become a local truth.

units.section_heading: Households — the unit of success we keep forgetting
units.spoken_text: Government budgets are organized by agencies. Markets report establishments and wages. Newspapers quote counties and GDP.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] Government budgets are organized by agencies. Markets report establishments and wages. Newspapers quote counties and GDP.

units.section_heading: Households — the unit of success we keep forgetting
units.spoken_text: But the unit of success for Constitutional Capitalism is the household: whether a family can meet necessities, keep some margin for shocks, own a stake in the future, and still have time left that belongs to them.

direction.performance_note: Unit of success definition. The book rests on this.

units.eleven_v3_tags: [slowly] [thoughtful] But the unit of success for Constitutional Capitalism is the household: whether a family can meet necessities, keep some margin for shocks, own a stake in the future, and still have time left that belongs to them.

units.section_heading: Households — the unit of success we keep forgetting
units.spoken_text: Arkansas' inherited machine does not primarily optimize for that.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] Arkansas' inherited machine does not primarily optimize for that.

units.section_heading: Households — the unit of success we keep forgetting
units.spoken_text: It taxes household and retail cashflow heavily, appropriates by agency, and then asks households to navigate the result: income pressure, housing, food, health access, energy, transportation, childcare, taxes, debt, thin savings, and time poverty.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] It taxes household and retail cashflow heavily, appropriates by agency, and then asks households to navigate the result: income pressure, housing, food, health access, energy, transportation, childcare, taxes, debt, thin savings, and time poverty.

units.section_heading: Households — the unit of success we keep forgetting
units.spoken_text: When the Rivers household has a bad month — a car repair, a medical bill, a lost shift — the state's revenue story and their kitchen-table story are the same story wearing two faces. That is not an insult to public finance. It is a diagnosis of how tightly Arkansas' operating budget is tied to household stress.

units.section_heading: A real economy — and a public revenue machine that rides on it
units.spoken_text: Arkansas is not an empty place waiting for an economy to arrive.

direction.performance_note: Quiet affirmation — Arkansas is not empty.

units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] Arkansas is not an empty place waiting for an economy to arrive.

units.section_heading: A real economy — and a public revenue machine that rides on it
units.spoken_text: Bound labor-market evidence shows roughly 1.10 million private-sector jobs and about 99,500 private establishments. Production is real. Wages are real. The question is not whether Arkansas produces — it is how surplus, ownership, and public revenue relate to household prosperity.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] Bound labor-market evidence shows roughly 1.10 million private-sector jobs and about 99,500 private establishments. Production is real. Wages are real. The question is not whether Arkansas produces — it is how surplus, ownership, and public revenue relate to household prosperity.

units.section_heading: A real economy — and a public revenue machine that rides on it
units.spoken_text: Here is the inherited fiscal picture in plain language.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] Here is the inherited fiscal picture in plain language.

units.section_heading: A real economy — and a public revenue machine that rides on it
units.spoken_text: In FY2026, gross General Revenue was about $8.69 billion. After the machinery of availability, about $7.15 billion was net available. About $6.49 billion appears as the Allocation A distributed General Revenue pattern — the operating cash that actually reaches agencies and institutions in the project's NOW bridge. Individual income tax brought in about $3.86 billion. Sales and use tax brought in about $3.67 billion. Corporate income tax was far smaller — about $0.52 billion.

Individual income tax brought in about $3.86 billion. Sales and use tax brought in about $3.67 billion. Corporate income tax was far smaller — about $0.52 billion.

units.section_heading: A real economy — and a public revenue machine that rides on it
units.spoken_text: Read that again the way the Rivers household would hear it: the state's largest public cash engines are taxes on wages and retail life.

direction.performance_note: Fiscal punchline. Lean on wages and retail; no sneer.

units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] Read that again the way the Rivers household would hear it: the state's largest public cash engines are taxes on wages and retail life.

units.section_heading: A real economy — and a public revenue machine that rides on it
units.spoken_text: That does not make those taxes 'wrong' by itself. It does mean that when households tighten spending or lose income, Arkansas' public balance sheet feels it quickly. A prosperity system that does not notice that coupling will keep confusing surplus seasons with structural health.

units.section_heading: Follow the public dollar — line-item optics vs. household effect
units.spoken_text: Once money arrives, Arkansas appropriates it largely by agency and institution.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] Once money arrives, Arkansas appropriates it largely by agency and institution.

units.section_heading: Follow the public dollar — line-item optics vs. household effect
units.spoken_text: In the bound FY2026 Allocation A pattern, Human Services is the largest selected share — on the order of 28.6% of distributed General Revenue in the seed classification. Higher education, corrections, and other large blocks follow. Education adequacy earmarks and other dedicated paths sit beside the agency map.

Higher education, corrections, and other large blocks follow. Education adequacy earmarks and other dedicated paths sit beside the agency map.

units.section_heading: Follow the public dollar — line-item optics vs. household effect
units.spoken_text: An ordinary Arkansan hearing 'the budget' often hears a moral story: too much here, too little there. The X-Ray asks a colder question first: what economic function is this money performing — transfer, custody, investment, operations, regulation — and what does it do to household capability?

The X-Ray asks a colder question first: what economic function is this money performing — transfer, custody, investment, operations, regulation — and what does it do to household capability?

units.section_heading: Follow the public dollar — line-item optics vs. household effect
units.spoken_text: Budget agency-line labels can hide that function. A dollar can look like 'compassion' or 'toughness' in a press release while acting as a recurring transfer, a custody obligation, or a long-lived institutional cost.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] Budget agency-line labels can hide that function. A dollar can look like 'compassion' or 'toughness' in a press release while acting as a recurring transfer, a custody obligation, or a long-lived institutional cost.

units.section_heading: Follow the public dollar — line-item optics vs. household effect
units.spoken_text: For Phillips County, the distance between a Little Rock agency line-item and a local clinic appointment is not a metaphor. It is logistics, workforce, and time. For the Rivers household, 'funded' and 'reachable this week' are different words.

direction.performance_note: Funded vs reachable. Logistics, not metaphor theater.

units.section_heading: Follow the public dollar — line-item optics vs. household effect
units.spoken_text: This book will later talk about redesign. Chapter 1 only insists on the inherited truth: Arkansas' public finance is a tax-and-appropriate machine organized by agency, not yet an integrated dashboard from people → households → money → assets → leakage.

units.section_heading: Productive assets we can name — and the register we still lack
units.spoken_text: Arkansas has productive capacity: establishments, higher-education appropriations, programs at scale, land and infrastructure that make daily life possible.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] Arkansas has productive capacity: establishments, higher-education appropriations, programs at scale, land and infrastructure that make daily life possible.

units.section_heading: Productive assets we can name — and the register we still lack
units.spoken_text: What Arkansas does not yet have, in the certified NOW baseline, is a complete public asset register and capital stock statement honest enough to treat as a statewide balance sheet.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] What Arkansas does not yet have, in the certified NOW baseline, is a complete public asset register and capital stock statement honest enough to treat as a statewide balance sheet.

units.section_heading: Productive assets we can name — and the register we still lack
units.spoken_text: That gap matters. People argue about 'public wealth' and 'selling the farm' without a shared inventory. Constitutional Capitalism refuses to invent valuations to win an argument.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] That gap matters. People argue about 'public wealth' and 'selling the farm' without a shared inventory. Constitutional Capitalism refuses to invent valuations to win an argument.

units.section_heading: Productive assets we can name — and the register we still lack
units.spoken_text: So the inherited X-Ray says: capacity is real; full visibility is incomplete; incomplete is not permission to fabricate.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] So the inherited X-Ray says: capacity is real; full visibility is incomplete; incomplete is not permission to fabricate.

units.section_heading: Productive assets we can name — and the register we still lack
units.spoken_text: When we later discuss public investment, ownership, and intergenerational capital, we will return to this honesty rule. A system that claims assets it cannot list is already failing the people who pay for it.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] When we later discuss public investment, ownership, and intergenerational capital, we will return to this honesty rule. A system that claims assets it cannot list is already failing the people who pay for it.

units.section_heading: Leakage and dependency — central, and easy to fake
units.spoken_text: Money leaves Arkansas' household and community circuits in many ways: ownership of local production by distant capital, profits and fees that settle elsewhere, supply chains that import what could be produced closer, talent that leaves, and federal program structures that both sustain and constrain.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] Money leaves Arkansas' household and community circuits in many ways: ownership of local production by distant capital, profits and fees that settle elsewhere, supply chains that import what could be produced closer, talent that leaves, and federal program structures that both sustain and constrain.

units.section_heading: Leakage and dependency — central, and easy to fake
units.spoken_text: Dependency is also real: federal funds, Medicaid continuity, corrections medical costs, earmarks, local school finance, and the quiet fact that some essential services do not presently run at intended scale on state dollars alone.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] Dependency is also real: federal funds, Medicaid continuity, corrections medical costs, earmarks, local school finance, and the quiet fact that some essential services do not presently run at intended scale on state dollars alone.

units.section_heading: Leakage and dependency — central, and easy to fake
units.spoken_text: Here is the discipline Stage 4 forced us to keep: do not invent a precise statewide 'leakage percentage' and call it fact.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [slowly] [thoughtful] Here is the discipline Stage 4 forced us to keep: do not invent a precise statewide 'leakage percentage' and call it fact.

units.section_heading: Leakage and dependency — central, and easy to fake
units.spoken_text: Over-precise fake totals feel like mastery. They are usually marketing.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] Over-precise fake totals feel like mastery. They are usually marketing.

units.section_heading: Leakage and dependency — central, and easy to fake
units.spoken_text: The Rivers household does not need a fake percentage to know when a plant closes, a clinic hour disappears, or a grocery bill rises because a supply chain snapped. Phillips County does not need a fake percentage to know population loss. This book will measure what can be measured and refuse theater where evidence is thin.

units.section_heading: The central problem, in one breath
units.spoken_text: Arkansas inherited a capable but leaky political-economic operating system.

direction.performance_note: Central problem in one breath. Do not race.

units.eleven_v3_tags: [slowly] [thoughtful] Arkansas inherited a capable but leaky political-economic operating system.

units.section_heading: The central problem, in one breath
units.spoken_text: Real people. Real production. Public finance that rides heavily on household and retail cashflow. Large recurring transfer and custody blocks. Incomplete public asset visibility. And no integrated NOW dashboard joining people → households → money → assets → leakage.
units.eleven_v3_tags: [measured] [thoughtful] Real people. Real production. Public finance that rides heavily on household and retail cashflow. Large recurring transfer and custody blocks. Incomplete public asset visibility. And no integrated NOW dashboard joining people → households → money → assets → leakage.

units.section_heading: The central problem, in one breath
units.spoken_text: Structural problems follow from that architecture: agency optics hiding economic function; revenue tied to household stress; large human-services and corrections obligations constraining naive 'just cut it' fantasies; rural decline patterns masked by statewide averages; leakage and dependency discussed more confidently than measured.

units.section_heading: The central problem, in one breath
units.spoken_text: What we are not claiming in this chapter: a complete all-funds federal picture; a perfect statewide leakage total; COUNTABLE replacement revenue ready to abolish major taxes tomorrow; or that a surplus season equals structural health.

units.section_heading: The central problem, in one breath
units.spoken_text: COUNTABLE public-income claims remain $0 until evidence clears the certified waterfall. That is not pessimism. It is the same honesty that survived Stage 4.

units.spoken_text: This opening exists so that every later chapter — prosperity, money, people as capital, productive systems, government, Constitutional Capitalism itself, the transition bridge, what we tried to break, and what Arkansas could leave behind — has somewhere solid to stand.
